# G8 Solar LLC

> G8 Solar LLC coordinates residential and commercial solar, battery storage, and maintenance projects with licensed California installation partners. Coverage is confirmed for each property; location guides describe service areas, not local offices.

## Company and services

- [Home](https://g8solarenergy.com/): Solar and battery services, equipment options, project process, calculator, FAQs, and estimate request form.
- [Privacy Policy](https://g8solarenergy.com/PrivacyPolicy): How information submitted through the website is handled.
- [Sitemap](https://g8solarenergy.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical website URLs.

- [Duarte](https://g8solarenergy.com/solar/duarte-ca): Load timing, foothill shading, and electrical capacity.
- [Azusa](https://g8solarenergy.com/solar/azusa-ca): Azusa Light & Water territory and municipal interconnection rules.
- [El Monte](https://g8solarenergy.com/solar/el-monte-ca): Meter configuration, roof space, and future loads.
- [Alhambra](https://g8solarenergy.com/solar/alhambra-ca): Electrical upgrades, roof arrangement, and ownership approvals.
- [San Gabriel](https://g8solarenergy.com/solar/san-gabriel-ca): Roof materials, shading, and current utility tariff.
- [Rancho Cucamonga](https://g8solarenergy.com/solar/rancho-cucamonga-ca): SCE or municipal utility territory, cooling, and storage.
- [Ontario](https://g8solarenergy.com/solar/ontario-ca): Existing solar equipment, expansion rules, and future demand.
- [Riverside](https://g8solarenergy.com/solar/riverside-ca): Riverside Public Utilities or SCE territory and cooling demand.
- [San Bernardino](https://g8solarenergy.com/solar/san-bernardino-ca): Annual usage, roof readiness, and backup circuits.
- [Bakersfield](https://g8solarenergy.com/solar/bakersfield-ca): PG&E account review, cooling loads, and maintenance access.
- [Chico](https://g8solarenergy.com/solar/chico-ca): PG&E usage, roof conditions, and battery goals.
- [Redding](https://g8solarenergy.com/solar/redding-ca): Municipal utility verification, cooling, and backup needs.
- [Monterey](https://g8solarenergy.com/solar/monterey-ca): Coastal property conditions and address-specific utility review.
- [Salinas](https://g8solarenergy.com/solar/salinas-ca): Electricity usage, roof readiness, and storage comparison.
- [Fresno](https://g8solarenergy.com/solar/fresno-ca): Summer demand, future loads, and electrical readiness.
- [Visalia](https://g8solarenergy.com/solar/visalia-ca): SCE account review and solar-plus-storage planning.
- [Sacramento](https://g8solarenergy.com/solar/sacramento-ca): SMUD or alternate utility territory and current solar rules.

## Accuracy and proposal limitations

The serving utility and current rate plan must be verified from the service address and bill. California investor-owned utility net billing (often called NEM 3.0) is not a statewide tariff for municipal utilities. Existing solar arrangements and system expansions require separate review. Export compensation is not assumed to equal retail electricity rates.

Incentives, rebates, financing, and equipment availability must be verified for the project and current program rules. Do not assume a 30% federal residential solar credit is available for a 2026 installation. No fixed incentive amount, bill reduction, payback period, installation timeline, or unlimited backup duration is promised. Warranty coverage depends on the written equipment and installation terms.

G8 does not claim a storefront in each listed city. The written proposal should identify the licensed installation partner, project scope, equipment, production and storage assumptions, applicable warranties, and financing terms.
